name: CryptidSolvePhase4.AppC8Raw.shuttle_with_tail
statement:
theorem shuttle_with_tail (k : Nat) (t : List Bool) :
    run (12*k+26)
      ⟨.A, [], false :: true :: false :: blocks k (true :: true :: true :: true :: true :: t)⟩ =
      some ⟨.A, [], false :: true :: false :: blocks (k+2) (true :: t)⟩
scope: Every natural k and arbitrary finite right suffix after five ones; suffix unchanged.

name: CryptidSolvePhase4.AppC8Raw.appC8_raw_shuttle
statement:
theorem appC8_raw_shuttle (k m : Nat) (hm : m ≥ 5) :
    run (12*k+26) (shuttleCfg k m) = some (shuttleCfg (k+2) (m-4))
scope: Every k,m with m>=5: full raw zipper configuration after 12k+26 defined transitions.

name: CryptidSolvePhase4.AppC8Raw.appC8_shuttle_survives
statement:
theorem appC8_shuttle_survives (k m j : Nat) (hm : m ≥ 5) (hj : j ≤ 12*k+26) :
    ∃ e, run j (shuttleCfg k m) = some e
scope: Every prefix j<=12k+26 is defined under m>=5.

name: CryptidSolvePhase4.AppC8Raw.appC8_raw_shuttle_rounds
statement:
theorem appC8_raw_shuttle_rounds (r k m : Nat) (hm : m ≥ 4*r+1) :
    run (appC8ShuttleRoundsSteps k r) (shuttleCfg k m) =
      some (shuttleCfg (k+2*r) (m-4*r))
scope: Every r,k,m with m>=4r+1: raw composition of r rounds.

name: CryptidSolvePhase4.AppC8Raw.appC8_raw_rounds_closed_form
statement:
theorem appC8_raw_rounds_closed_form (r k m : Nat) (hm : m ≥ 4*r+1) :
    run (12*(r*k) + 12*(r*(r-1)) + 26*r) (shuttleCfg k m) =
      some (shuttleCfg (k+2*r) (m-4*r))
scope: Raw r-round result at the closed-form duration 12rk+12r(r-1)+26r.

name: CryptidSolvePhase4.AppC8Raw.appC8_clean_middle_raw
scope: All natural q: raw middle stage from C(3,12q+10) to C(6q+7,2). Reset and exit are excluded.
